description: How fast coins in a given risk band actually rugged: median seconds from GROUNDTRUTH first seeing the curve to the rug, with p25 and p75, for one chain, band and window. Use it to answer "how long would I have had". The denominator is calls that rugged in the window AND carry a rug time, and it travels in the answer. Below 30 such calls the percentiles are null and enough_data is false -- say "not enough resolved calls to state a time" rather than quoting a number. Omit every argument to get the whole table in one call.

band.description: the band GROUNDTRUTH assigned at the time of the call

name: groundtruth_time_to_rug
